name: Death is NOT for Today
source:
A little visual novel where you need to convince the death to leave you alive! Retry a few times because there is more than one ending to your story!

[From [url=https://mimstar.itch.io/death-is-not-for-today]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部小型视觉小说，你需要说服死神，让自己活下去！多试几次吧，你的故事可不只有一种结局！

[摘自[url=https://mimstar.itch.io/death-is-not-for-today]itch.io[/url]]
